newsitem.title: USA: BankBoston to redeem Series E pfd shrs.
newsitem.headline: BankBoston to redeem Series E pfd shrs.

text.p: BankBoston Corp said Thursday it will redeem all 9.2 million depositary shares of its 8.6 percent cumulative series E preferred stock for $25.00 a share on September 15.
The bank holding company said it will pay a last regular dividend on the preferred stock of $0.5375 per depositary share September 15 to holders of record on August 15.
BankBoston said the series E preferred stock's total liquidation preference amounts to $230 million.
Over-the-counter trading in BankBoston's series E preferred shares was halted, with the last sale at 25-7/16.
Seperately, the bank declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.51 a share on its common stock, payable on August 29 to stockholders of record on August 4.
